# Model Invocation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](gmeow-ModelInvocation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ModelInvocation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

One call to a generative model: the model agent ([`gmeow:usedModel`](../properties/gmeow-usedModel.md)), the prompts presented ([`gmeow:hasPrompt`](../properties/gmeow-hasPrompt.md)), and the sampling parameters. The provenance anchor of every generated claim — a claim node [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) its invocation and [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) the model agent (both EXISTING provenance properties), so 'which model, under which prompt and parameters, at what time?' is answerable after the fact. Outputs are linked FROM the output via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md); no forward output property exists (P5).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record one call to a generative model as the provenance anchor of its outputs — which model, prompts, and sampling parameters produced a claim; the [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) target of every generated claim node (the [`ModelInvocation`](gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) idiom).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting a forward output property on it (outputs link back via the existing [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md), P5) and avoid using it for the model identity itself (that is [`gmeow:SoftwareAgent`](gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) + [`gmeow:ModelCard`](gmeow-ModelCard.md)); the invocation is the act, an occurrent, not the agent.

### How to use

- Type the call [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) (a [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md), hence [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)), set [`gmeow:usedModel`](../properties/gmeow-usedModel.md) and one or more [`gmeow:hasPrompt`](../properties/gmeow-hasPrompt.md), record sampling parameters, and carry its temporal reference frame on [`gmeow:eventTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-eventTemporalFrame.md) since it is an occurrent (P11); link outputs back via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](../properties/gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md).
